technical_claims.text: Unsaved memo edits survive leaving and returning through a sessionStorage draft.
Svelte has low runtime overhead and a light bundle appropriate for this personal tool.
Supabase concurrency throughput is not a bottleneck.

evidence.observation: Root Node package builds web and starts server/server.js.
Svelte browser application with pages, components, API service and PDF utilities.
Express backend entry point with API routes and static web serving.
One shared request wrapper owns browser API calls.
Central Zotero client owns authenticated reads and writes.
Persistence methods consistently derive user_id from request context.
Paper list, detail, webpage, delete, memo and attachment routes.
Highlight and ink API paths validate ownership against the paper attachment.
Paper table is explicitly a metadata cache with user-scoped uniqueness and query indexes.
AsyncLocalStorage carries the authenticated user through asynchronous request work.
Autosave serializes requests and mirrors edits to sessionStorage.
PDF-specific reusable geometry, touch and browser compatibility utilities.
Paper presentation is reused by home, list, search and collection pages.
Synchronization processes incremental changes, tolerates per-item errors, then writes a global checkpoint.
Scripts install dependencies, build the web app, run the server and perform migration.
Container build runs npm ci and npm run build before starting the application.
README promises that pre-save edits remain recoverable after navigation.
Framework choice includes comparative runtime and bundle-size claims without recorded measurements.
The document declares database concurrent-write throughput non-bottleneck without workload evidence.

limitations: No target-provided code, dependency installer, build, test, container, migration or application was executed.
No credentials, Supabase database, Zotero account, browser runtime, production traffic, query plan or performance measurements were available.
Runtime-dependent impact is reported as SUSPECTED; deterministic code paths are CODE_PROVEN.
